verdicts.reason: Both use the same stacked skyscraper layout, and both share the same flaws. The flavour pills have different widths and ragged centring, so they don't line up with the left text edge, and their order is reversed from the original. The CTA and the headline run almost to the canvas edges, and the fine print is tiny. A is slightly worse: there is a large dead gap between the headline and the body copy, and the body copy breaks awkwardly as "one / long season". B keeps the headline and body copy together as a group and wraps the line more cleanly.
